name: io.github.legumeinfo/legumista
title: Legumista
description: Legume genomics over MCP: the LIS Data Store catalog, InterMine queries, scholarly search, NCBI/EDirect, and pysam tools.

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server (stdio) via `uvx legumista mcp`. Append '--allow-write' to permit write operations.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory the genomics tools may read local files from (they are sandboxed to it). Defaults to the working directory; also settable with `legumista mcp -C DIR`.

environmentVariables.name: LEGUMISTA_PYSAM_ALLOWED_URLS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated http(s) URL-prefix allowlist for the genomics tools; when unset, any public host is allowed (private/loopback are always blocked).
